in_marathi.name: Samarveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे All-Knowing, Wise, Victorious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samarveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Samarveer is a name derived from the Sanskrit language that translates to 'all-knowing' or 'wise' in English. The name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology and is believed to signify one who is knowledgeable, learned, and victorious. This name is often given to children as a symbol of wisdom and strength.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Samarveer' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'समर्' meaning battlefield or battle, and 'वीर्' meaning brave or heroic. It signifies one who possesses the courage and strength to face challenges on a battlefield or in life.
